summary.text: Son of Eurytus of Oechalia, Argonaut who later gave his bow to Odysseus and was thrown from the walls of Tiryns by Heracles.

story.text: Hyginus counts Iphitus son of Eurytus among the Argonauts. After the voyage he trusted Heracles when cattle were stolen and was murdered in madness — but not before giving Odysseus the great bow.
